/--
For a field specification `��`, and two lists `φs = φ₀…φₙ` and `φs'` of `��.CrAnFieldOp`
the following super commutation relation holds:

`[φs', φ₀…φₙ]ₛca = ∑ i, ��(φs', φ₀…φᵢ₋₁) • φ₀…φᵢ₋₁ * [φs', φᵢ]ₛca * φᵢ₊₁ … φₙ`

The proof of this relation is via induction on the length of `φs`.
-/
lemma superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF_eq_sum (φs : List ��.CrAnFieldOp) :
    (φs' : List ��.CrAnFieldOp) → [ofCrAnListF φs, ofCrAnListF φs']ₛca =
    ∑ (n : Fin φs'.length), ��(�� |>ₛ φs, �� |>ₛ φs'.take n) •
    ofCrAnListF (φs'.take n) * [ofCrAnListF φs, ofCrAnOpF (φs'.get n)]ₛca *
    ofCrAnListF (φs'.drop (n + 1))
  | [] => by
    simp [← ofCrAnListF_nil, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
  | φ :: φs' => by
    rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF_cons,
      superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF_eq_sum φs φs']
    conv_rhs => erw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    congr 1

        FieldStatistic.ofList_cons_eq_mul, mul_comm]

informal_statement:
For any lists of commutative algebra operations `φs` and `φs'`, the equality between the supercommutator of `ofCrAnList φs` and `ofFieldOpList φs'` holds, which is expressed as:

\[
\left[ ofCrAnList \, \phi s, \, ofFieldOpList \, \phi s' \right] = \sum_{n : Fin \, \phi s'.length} \mathcal{S} \left( \mathcal{F} \upharpoonright_{\phi s}, \, \mathcal{F} \upharpoonright_{\phi s'.take \, n} \right) \, \cdot \, ofFieldOpList \, \left( \phi s'.take \, n \right) \times \left[ ofCrAnList \, \phi s, \, ofFieldOp \, \left( \phi s'.get \, n \right) \right] \times ofFieldOpList \, \left( \phi s'.drop \, (n + 1) \right)
\]
